deviations.what: The base set is built with year = fy + 0:base_years, so a patent filed in focal year t is counted in t's own base window (t-5 to t) instead of t-5 to t-1; it should be fy + 1:base_years, which also fixes the violated rule 6 and the 'adding a patent filed in year t changes nothing' check.

notes: The forward window (line 13), the anti-join for new classes (line 17), the empty-base and no-forward handling (lines 23-26), de-duplication and output shape all match the spec. Focal years 1987-2015 are not enforced in code; output follows whatever firm_year the caller passes, which matches the Inputs definition.
